Class SlotLooks

java.lang.Object
com.trevlar.slotkit.api.item.SlotLooks
public final class SlotLooks extends Object
How a slot draws an item while something holds for it: an animation, another model, or a mark under or over it. "Something" is an ItemState the item carries, or a SlotLooks.When the mod answers on the client from what it already knows (an open session, a lock). SlotKit times the animation by the item and MenuKit draws (SlotItemLooks, SlotDecorations), so a mod writes neither a mixin nor a lookup of which item a slot shows. Client side; declare from the client initializer, with ids unique per mod. 
static final Transition OPENING = Transition.of(250, Easing.EASE_OUT);

SlotLooks.animate("mymod:open_lid", OPEN, ItemAnimation.OPEN_LID, OPENING);
SlotLooks.over("mymod:open_mark", OPEN, (g, screen, slot, stack, x, y) -> g.fill(x, y, x + 16, y + 16, 0x80606060));
Since 2.2.0.

    • animate

      public static void animate(String id, ItemState<?> state, com.trevlar.menukit.api.element.ItemAnimation animation, com.trevlar.menukit.api.element.Transition transition)
      The item plays animation toward its end while it carries state, and back when the state clears. The timing follows the item (ItemSources.pathOf(Player, Slot) where the item has a path, otherwise its place in the slot's container), so a screen opened in place of another picks a running animation up where it stood. Compose a model swap with ItemAnimation.swapped(UnaryOperator).
